name: feature-grid
title: Feature grid
description: What a product does, a card per feature in the website's double rule: a red pixel pattern, the name in Faculty Glyphic and its line. One across on phones, two from 640px, three from 1024px.
use_for: The band on a home or product page that says what it does, three to six things.
never: More than six features: say the six that matter
Icons from an icon set: the marks are the hero tabs' pixel patterns
source: conare-web app/pages/pricing.vue (the Enterprise cards: off-white in the double rule, led by a pattern), app/components/home/Products.vue (the grid's double rule), app/content/patterns.ts
body: The marks take the hero tabs' four pixel patterns in turn. An odd last card on two columns takes the whole row.

examples.name: Site
examples.label: Six features
examples.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import FeatureGrid from '@/components/site/FeatureGrid.vue'
// What a product does, six features in the double rule.
const features = [
  {
    "title": "Search",
    "body": "Ask in plain words and get the passages that answer, ranked, with where each came from."
  },
  {
    "title": "Sync",
    "body": "Connect the apps your team uses. A changed record replaces the old one; a deleted one is deleted."
  },
  {
    "title": "Parse",
    "body": "Read any file in full: every page, table, row and cell, scanned or typed."
  },
  {
    "title": "Embed",
    "body": "Embeddings for any vector database, from the same models search runs on."
  },
  {
    "title": "Rerank",
    "body": "Put the best passages first, in one call after the search you already run."
  },
  {
    "title": "Audit",
    "body": "Every search, what it read and how long it took, kept for as long as you need."
  }
]
</script>

<template>
  <FeatureGrid
    tag="Product"
    title="Everything retrieval needs, behind one key."
    :features="features"
  />
</template>
